headline: Indian IT services showed uneven growth, with AI‑led firms outpacing slower‑moving peers.
summary: Revenue grew across most majors, but the pace varied from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. Profit margins improved for HCLTech and TCS, while Infosys trimmed guidance and Wipro saw profit dip. AI revenue contributed materially, especially at HCLTech and Mphasis. Dividend payouts remained modest.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: AI revenue rose sharply at several firms, boosting profit growth at HCLTech and Mphasis.

themes.title: Margin divergence
themes.detail: Operating margins expanded at high‑growth firms like Coforge and TCS, but stayed flat or fell at slower growers.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance, reflecting cautious outlook; other peers kept guidance unchanged.

themes.title: Dividend stability
themes.detail: Most companies maintained or modestly increased dividends despite mixed earnings.

leaders.why: Revenue up 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance raised to 16%.
11.5% revenue growth, 21% profit jump and $219 m AI revenue.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to ~1% YoY and FY27 guidance cut to 1‑2%.
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but profit fell 1.9% and headcount declined.
